member.name: T:SampleApplication.Program
member.summary: Sample application that runs the Switchboard daemon in-process (no Docker) as a reverse proxy and API gateway in front of three WatsonWebserver origin servers. Several routes are load balanced across different subsets of the origins so the routing and load-balancing behavior is observable from a simple HTTP client such as curl.

member.name: P:SampleApplication.Program.DefaultProxyPort
member.summary: Default TCP port the Switchboard proxy listens on when no override is supplied.

member.name: M:SampleApplication.Program.Main(System.String[])
member.summary: Entry point. Starts the three origins and the Switchboard daemon, waits for the origins to become healthy, then runs until Ctrl+C.
member.param: Optional command-line arguments. The first argument, when present and a valid port, overrides the proxy port (default is ).
member.returns: A task that completes when the application shuts down.

member.name: T:SampleApplication.SampleOriginServer
member.summary: A single backend origin server hosted with WatsonWebserver. Every response identifies the node that served it, so the effect of Switchboard's load balancing and per-route origin sets is visible to the caller. Each origin answers the same set of routes; Switchboard is responsible for deciding which origins are eligible for a given route.

member.name: P:SampleApplication.SampleOriginServer.NodeNumber
member.summary: Node number this origin identifies as in its responses. Minimum is 1.

member.name: P:SampleApplication.SampleOriginServer.Port
member.summary: TCP port this origin listens on (bound to localhost). Range is 1 to 65535.

member.name: M:SampleApplication.SampleOriginServer.#ctor(System.Int32,System.Int32)
member.summary: Initialize (but do not start) an origin server for the given node number and port.
member.param: Node number echoed in responses. Minimum is 1.
TCP port to bind on localhost. Range is 1 to 65535.
member.exception: Thrown when is less than 1, or is outside 1 to 65535.

member.name: M:SampleApplication.SampleOriginServer.Start
member.summary: Start listening for requests on the configured port.

member.name: M:SampleApplication.SampleOriginServer.Dispose
member.summary: Stop listening and release the underlying webserver.
